findings.title: The injection fence makes the agent distrust the requestor's own words — a correction is refused as 'external unverified input'
findings.expected: A correction after the read-back ('Kafka není nutná') lands in the brief as the requestor's stated revision.
findings.got: Agent: 'ta poslední zpráva o Kafce nepřišla ověřeně od vás — dorazila z externího zdroje, takže ji do zadání sám nepropíšu' — refused the demotion, kept Kafka must_have, stored a paranoid facet ('Neověřený vstup k požadavkům', úsudek AI). Root cause: intake.py reuses devcase's fenced_untrusted framing, designed for ADVERSARY-authored content, on the authenticated operator's own message.
findings.l2_note: Silver lining confirmed live: the refusal facet was honestly marked 'úsudek AI', never 'řekli jste'.

findings.title: Deterministic close invites a correction it cannot accept — read-back + <<END>> + done in one turn locks the composer
findings.expected: Read-back waits one turn for confirmation/correction; only a confirm closes the session.
findings.got: intake.py deterministic_turn emits the read-back with <<END>> and done=true simultaneously; status flips complete; the message route 409s the invited correction.

findings.title: Spine scalars carry no provenance — the default 'medior' renders unmarked and reads as captured
findings.expected: A defaulted seniority is visibly 'assumed' in the panel and absent from the sign-off read-back.
findings.got: RoleBrief has per-requirement/facet provenance but none on title/seniority/role_family; the default renders chipless and propagates to the JD build.

findings.title: Czech power-unit markers miss inflected forms (posilu/náhradu/dalšího) — keyless backfills fall to the 11-exchange story script
findings.expected: An inflected Czech backfill opener triages power_unit on the deterministic floor.
findings.got: The trailing \b in _POWER_UNIT_MARKERS requires a word boundary right after the stem, so Czech inflections fail (regex executed by the L1 agent).
findings.l2_note: Live (LLM path) the triage was correct — the floor is keyless-only, matching the product's degradation contract, hence major-not-blocker.

findings.title: role_family silently stays software_engineering for non-tech roles — through promote into the JD/job
findings.expected: A clinical intake lands role_family healthcare_clinical (deterministic classification exists in the taxonomy).
findings.got: Deterministic path never sets family; the LLM is never given the 16-family vocabulary; the default threads into jd_build and the ingested job.

findings.title: Skip answers stored as facet values on the LLM path ('Why now: přeskočit', chipped řekli jste)
findings.expected: A skip is never data (the deterministic path already enforces this).
findings.got: Live brief shows the skip word as a stated why_now facet; facet label also code-switched to English ('Why now') mid-Czech dialog.

findings.title: The brief dies as a structured object at the dev-case seam
findings.expected: Her headline JTBD: the promoted brief feeds dev-case design structurally.
findings.got: Promote UI never offers caseDesign (bodyless POST); the Dev tab re-extracts the need from JD markdown; promotedBriefForJob has one consumer (interview grounding).

findings.title: Promote hardcodes marketResearch:true — a Czech-market comp read auto-attaches to any promoted JD
findings.expected: Opt-out (her non-Czech clinical roles would carry a wrong-market band).
findings.got: options.marketResearch is literal true in the promote route.
findings.ceiling: Even with an opt-out, the market layer itself is Czech-single-market (documented workspace ceiling).

findings.title: 30–40s per exchange behind a static 'Přemýšlím…' — no progress or timeout affordance (confirms L1-TOM-7)
findings.expected: Latency acknowledged (elapsed hint or staged status) at coaching pace.
findings.got: Measured 30977–39511ms per live exchange; the indicator never changes.

findings.title: STRENGTH — the live dialog clears the register bar: correct shape triage, one question/turn, requestor's words reused, grounded read-back, honest provenance chips, clean Czech, promote→JD end-to-end
findings.got: Confirmed across shots 02–99: 6-question short path for the backfill, all captured values chipped 'řekli jste', title/shape/status live, JD created with background task visible.
